q: The Perron-Frobenius theorem applied to the adjacency matrix A of an irreducible SFT gives the topological entropy as log ρ(A). The unique measure of maximal entropy (Parry measure) is the Markov measure with transition matrix:
opts: Aᵢⱼ uⱼ / (ρ uᵢ) where u is the right Perron eigenvector
exp: Parry measure: transition probability Pᵢⱼ = Aᵢⱼ vⱼ / (ρ vᵢ) using the right Perron eigenvector v. The initial distribution π is given by the left eigenvector (πᵢ = uᵢvᵢ / Σⱼ uⱼvⱼ). This is the unique shift-invariant measure of maximal entropy.
